coaching.headline: They won most of the fights. We took their base without losing an inhibitor. A proper fucking comeback.
coaching.team: Down four towers before we had taken one of theirs, with two Fangtooths and a Genesis Core gone the same way, the map was theirs. Then the big prizes went the other way: both Primal Fangtooths, Orb Prime, three inhibitors and the Core. Three of our four won fights became an objective or structure; they converted half of their ten. We also took a tower and the first Primal Fangtooth in the same windows as fights we lost. Taking the map, more than winning fights, is how this flipped.

focus.title: One down, don't force it
focus.evidence: Twice one of us died outside any fight shortly before a fight we then lost, and both times their Fangtooth or a tower followed.
focus.action: When one of us dies before a Fangtooth or tower comes up, the other four fall back to the next tower instead of fighting a body down. Next game, count their takes right after one of our deaths outside a fight.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 ran the most complete game on our side, and it was not fucking close. Gideon beat his own usual farm and damage on the hero, finished richest in the lobby, and took kills off four different enemies, Legion three times. That is the standard. Argus and Khaimera split his four deaths, and both Argus kills came outside any recorded fight. When Argus has not shown and Gideon has to cross the map, keep the portal for the exit.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs took Khaimera down four times, more than anyone else on our side, and led our objective damage by a distance. That is jungle pressure with actual teeth. Ten deaths is a hell of a bill, though, and two of them came outside any recorded fight shortly before each of their Fangtooths. Next game, when Fangtooth is about a minute out, Feng Mao paths toward the pit and waits for the team's call before taking any new trade.
perPlayer.08bea990-2b35-47e0-85a5-93f4545532c2: A rough night for MarKnoop, and it does not need dressing up. Sparrow gave up first blood to Legion, died more than twice the usual count on less than the usual damage, and Khaimera had Sparrow on speed dial for four of the seven. The Khaimera kill in the second Primal Fangtooth fight is the one to build on. When Khaimera is unseen, Sparrow plays behind Maco, the front-line build, and holds Heightened Senses as the answer to the leap.
perPlayer.b5210bcc-5219-4b31-b552-f4943b07e036: Maco did the support job that shows up on paper: the most healing in the lobby, our highest mitigation, more wards than Argus and a hand in over half our kills. The bodies were the cost. Khaimera killed him four times, and one death outside any fight came just before our first tower and their first Fangtooth fell. When Khaimera leaps onto Sparrow or Maco, Maco fires Phantom Rush for speed and slow immunity on the way out.
perPlayer.f3790729-823f-4410-98f5-287108c302b0: Iggy & Scorch owned our most lopsided win: Argus, Terra and Khaimera in one exchange, then two of their inner towers and an inhibitor fell. Damage ran about a third above his usual on the hero, and he took the last kill before the Core. Terra was the recurring problem, credited with three of his five deaths. Terra's ultimate cleanses debuffs and adds both armors for several seconds, so Iggy & Scorch holds Inferno until that buff ends.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Mid opponent: Gadget, a zone mage whose Security Gate roots and whose final build added Spellbreaker's spell shield. Across the map, Argus, a long-range poke mage with a stun, was credited with two of Gideon's four deaths, and Khaimera's leap is the dive threat to a caster whose only escape is the portal.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Azure Core, Combustion and Wraith Leggings is the common winning mid core, and he had all three. Azure Core turns mana stacks from kills into magical power and adds a low-health shield; Combustion splashes damage on ability hits; Wraith Leggings adds ability damage against low-health heroes. Oblivion Crown multiplies magical power. Tainted Scepter cuts healing on any magical hit, with real targets in Khaimera's lifesteal and Legion's Nightfall. Spellbreaker's spell shield blocks one ability, such as Gadget's root or Argus's stun. Proc counts are not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vesh adds a damage-over-time slice of ability damage that grows with game time, which suits a long game. Tithe of Death returns mana and permanent ability haste on takedowns, and Gideon was involved in plenty. Phylactery speeds cooldowns and grants a mana-based shield after Black Hole, pairing with Gideon's mana scaling. Mind Rot is the slot-two alternative when raw damage matters more than the post-ultimate shield; nothing here shows the shield was wasted.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Infinite Impact gives Void Breach unlimited range, turning the comet into long-range poke and a slow that can reach a fleeing target. The record cannot show how often it landed. Event Horizon, extra max-health damage in Cosmic Rift's center, is the alternative into a health-stacking front like Terra; this game does not prove either choice better.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Epoch puts Gideon into a short stasis. It is the answer to Khaimera's leap or Argus's burst when the portal is already spent, at the cost of standing still while enemies wait it out. Activation timing is not recorded, so the deaths cannot be tied to whether it was available.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: Keep it. He had the winning core plus two situational items with clear targets in this draft. The only comparison worth making is Spellbreaker against a physical-armor item if Khaimera, a physical diver, becomes the main threat: Spellbreaker blocks one ability and adds magical armor, but gives nothing against basic attacks. This win does not prove the swap.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.matchup: Jungle opponent: Khaimera, a sustain duelist whose damage heals him. He finished with Terminus, lifesteal that overflows into a shield, and Mutilator's max-health hits, and he had the most kills in the match. The gank targets carried their own answers: Legion's Mesmer blocks one ability and Nightfall heals from ability damage, while Terra stacked armor through Stonewall and Vainglory. The record does not show which lanes Feng Mao ganked.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Manta Scythe, Omen and The Perforator is the common winning core for jungle Feng Mao, so the base was standard. The Perforator ignores part of physical armor, which matters into Terra's Stonewall and Vainglory. Tainted Trident cuts healing on anything he hits with physical damage, a direct answer to Khaimera's lifesteal and Legion's Nightfall. Draconum adds armor and takedown healing. The final inventory does not show when Trident arrived or how often its anti-heal sat on Khaimera.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Demiurge boosts item stats and item-effect damage, which suits an item-driven bruiser, and Tri-Core adds random-type on-hit damage. Cursed Corrupted converts critical chance into ability haste, but none of the five finished items carries critical chance, so that minor had little or nothing to convert from items. Bloatware, a small damage and damage-reduction bonus per item, is the slot-two option that pays without crit.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.augment: Ichorous Glaive restores a share of missing health on every unit kill and far more on an Earth Shatter execution. It pays during clears and on finished targets, not during the trade before them. Imperial Duelist, a basic-attack debuff that adds damage dealt and cuts damage taken against that target, is the alternative when extended duels with Khaimera are the problem. Execute counts are not recorded.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.crest: Ortus grants movement speed and physical power for a few seconds, and takedowns inside that window add permanent power and refresh it. It rewards entering a fight that is about to produce kills, like the Khaimera takedowns; as an escape it only offers speed. Activation timing is not recorded.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.improvement: Keep Manta Scythe, Omen, The Perforator and Tainted Trident while Khaimera is the jungle opponent. The free fix is at the loadout screen: swap Cursed Corrupted for Bloatware, since this build gave the crit conversion nothing to work with. That costs no item slot and adds a little damage reduction. It is not a claim that any particular death would have been prevented.

08bea990-2b35-47e0-85a5-93f4545532c2.matchup: Duo lane: Sparrow and Maco against Legion and Argus. Legion took first blood on Sparrow and finished with Mesmer's spell shield, Nightfall's ability healing and Tainted Trident. Khaimera, credited with four of Sparrow's seven deaths, was the bigger threat: a leaping, stunning duelist against a carry whose only escape is a short stealth. Terra's Stonewall and Vainglory stacked armor in front of everything Sparrow wanted to shoot.
08bea990-2b35-47e0-85a5-93f4545532c2.build: Storm Breaker and Sky Splitter are two-thirds of the common winning core; the missing piece is Spectra, whose on-hit stacks trigger a missing-health burst. Sky Splitter's current-health damage, reduced for ranged heroes, still chews through a tanky front like Terra, and Storm Breaker chains lightning across several targets. Onixian Quiver adds two extra projectiles per attack, Dust Devil stacks attack speed and movement while hitting heroes, and Vanquisher executes heroes at very low health. The final inventory does not show when these came online.
08bea990-2b35-47e0-85a5-93f4545532c2.eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles when Sparrow damages a low-health hero, more with bonus attack speed, so it rewards finishing. Forage adds gold and experience per minion or monster. Wind-Rider triggers on leaving stealth, which Heightened Senses supplies, so it fits the kit. Natural Resistance, a cleanse and tenacity when low, is the slot-one alternative when Khaimera's stun is ending fights, at the cost of Forage's farm.
08bea990-2b35-47e0-85a5-93f4545532c2.augment: Sun Shards makes basic attacks ricochet to extra targets at reduced on-hit strength, which stacks with Storm Breaker's chains and Onixian Quiver's extra projectiles in grouped fights. It adds little when Sparrow is the one being dived. Ricochet hits are not recorded, so there is no basis to call Inner Fury or Endless Hunt a proven upgrade.
08bea990-2b35-47e0-85a5-93f4545532c2.crest: Eviscerator grants attack speed, omnivamp and empowered basic attacks for a few seconds: an all-in damage window, not an escape. Against Khaimera's dives it only helps if Sparrow can keep shooting through them, and it does not move her. Activation timing is not recorded.
08bea990-2b35-47e0-85a5-93f4545532c2.improvement: Spectra, the missing piece of the common winning core, is the comparison for the Dust Devil slot: a missing-health burst on stacked targets in exchange for Dust Devil's attack speed and the movement speed that matters when Khaimera dives. If Khaimera keeps reaching Sparrow, Natural Resistance over Forage is the loadout-screen comparison: a cleanse when low in exchange for farm income. The deaths alone do not prove which change would have helped more.

b5210bcc-5219-4b31-b552-f4943b07e036.matchup: Duo lane: Maco and Sparrow against Argus and Legion. Argus pokes from range with a stun and finished with Entropy and Crescelia for ability and empowered-attack damage; Legion took first blood. Khaimera, a leaping basic-attack duelist credited with four of Maco's deaths, was the real pressure on the duo, and Gadget's Tesla Dome adds a heavy slow to any grouped fight.
b5210bcc-5219-4b31-b552-f4943b07e036.build: Maco skipped the common support core of Crescelia, Enra's Blessing and Windcaller for a front-line kit. Hexbound Bracers returns mana from damage taken and trims hero basic-attack damage; Tainted Guard adds armor and cuts the healing of whoever basic-attacks him, Khaimera included. Frosted Lure fires damage, a slow and a shield after he spends a few seconds near enemy heroes, then goes on a long cooldown, and Vyzar Carapace shields him once his own attacks and abilities stack three hits on an enemy hero. Timewarp shortens basic cooldowns. It fits our highest mitigation; it does not prove the build won or lost any fight.
b5210bcc-5219-4b31-b552-f4943b07e036.eternal: Knell shreds both armors with each hero hit and hands Maco part of what it shreds, so it pays when he is in the fight hitting heroes. Patina's shield only rebuilds after a stretch without taking damage, so it is a between-fights cushion. Resonant Repair heals and grants tenacity whenever he is immobilized, which fits Khaimera's stun and Argus's control. The field most often runs Exarch on Maco; this match cannot say whether it would have done more.
b5210bcc-5219-4b31-b552-f4943b07e036.augment: Ferocious Flight adds shielding and shortens Maco Fly's cooldown for each enemy the slam hits, so landing it on several bodies pays twice: more protection and a faster next leap. That suits a support who stands in front. The record cannot show how many targets each slam hit. Shatterbloom, a healing field from Maco Strike, is the alternative when the job is sustaining a grouped team rather than surviving the front.
b5210bcc-5219-4b31-b552-f4943b07e036.crest: Leafsong's Phantom Rush gives nearby allies a burst of speed, slow immunity and the ability to pass through heroes for a few seconds, and its Visionary passive raises the ward cap with Solstone. Against Gadget's Tesla Dome, Argus's crystal and Khaimera's slow, that is a group engage or escape button, and the extra ward slot fits Maco out-warding Argus. Activation timing is not recorded.
b5210bcc-5219-4b31-b552-f4943b07e036.improvement: Keep the front-line shape. If Khaimera keeps reaching the duo, compare Enra's Blessing against Claw Of Hermes: Enra's shields a nearby ally the moment they are immobilized, protection for Sparrow instead of mana-burn damage. That trades Claw's mana-burn damage for a reactive save. This win does not prove the swap was needed.

f3790729-823f-4410-98f5-287108c302b0.matchup: Offlane opponent: Terra, an unstoppable initiator who finished on both armors through Stonewall, Vainglory, Cybernetic Drive and Tainted Bastion, the last of which cuts the healing of anyone who hits her with magical damage. She was credited with three of Iggy & Scorch's five deaths and had the highest mitigation in the match. Khaimera's leap is the other threat to an immobile zone mage.
f3790729-823f-4410-98f5-287108c302b0.build: Megacosm is one piece of the common winning core; its max-health and bonus-health burn fits Terra's health. Magnify shreds magical armor on ability hits, aimed at Tainted Bastion and Cybernetic Drive. Noxia adds max-health damage when a second ability hits a marked hero, which layered fire makes easy. Tainted Scepter cuts healing on any magical hit, and Golem's Gift holds power and armor stacks that drain under physical hits from heroes and refill on casts. Vanquisher's execute works for anyone, but its physical power, penetration and crit add little to a magical damage dealer.
f3790729-823f-4410-98f5-287108c302b0.eternal: Knell is a rare choice on offlane Iggy & Scorch, where Vesh is the usual pick, but it has a logic here: repeated attack and ability hits shred both armors on a resist-stacking Terra and hand him part of it. Frequency adds attack speed and ability haste per Rust stack, and Fracture adds damage against fully stacked targets. Vesh with Lich would trade the shred for burn and lifesteal, and Tainted Bastion would cut that lifesteal whenever he hits Terra.
f3790729-823f-4410-98f5-287108c302b0.augment: Turret Maniac raises the turret cap by one at the cost of turret health: more fireballs to redirect onto a target and more sources of Ignite on Slick-stacked enemies. The record does not count turret uptime or damage. Hold This!, Molotov explosion damage that grows with every hero hit, is the alternative for a long game; nothing here proves it would have done more.
f3790729-823f-4410-98f5-287108c302b0.crest: Soulbearer gives a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for several seconds. Against Terra's charge or Khaimera's leap it is a window to survive and keep burning, not an escape, and the lifesteal is cut whenever he hits Terra while Tainted Bastion is active. Activation timing is not recorded.
f3790729-823f-4410-98f5-287108c302b0.improvement: Vanquisher is the slot to rethink. Entropy, part of the winning core, adds damage on every ability hit and suits his layered zones; that trades a low-health execute for steady magical damage. Everything else in the build has a target in this draft. This win does not prove the swap; it shows where the free value sits.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.
